#nullable enable

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using T;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(options => {
    options.SerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;
    options.SerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
});

builder.Services.AddDbContext<TDbCtx>(options => options.UseInMemoryDatabase("T"));

var app = builder.Build();

using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<TDbCtx>();
    await SeedAsync(db);
}

app.MapGet("/api/pairs", async (TDbCtx db) => await db.Pairs.ToListAsync());

app.MapGet("/api/pairs/{id}", async (int id, TDbCtx db) => (await db.Pairs.FindAsync(id) is T.Pair pair ? Results.Ok(pair) : StatusProblem(404, "Not Found")));

app.MapPost("/api/pairs", async (PairDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var pairResult = T.Pair.Create(dto.Lo, dto.Hi, dto.Code, dto.Tag);
    if (!pairResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        return Problem(pairResult.Error!);
    }
    db.Pairs.Add(pairResult.Value);
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    return Results.Ok(pairResult.Value);
});

app.MapPost("/api/pairs/{id}/both", async (int id, BothDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var entity = await db.Pairs.FindAsync(id);
    if (entity == null)
    {
        return StatusProblem(404, "Not Found", "Pair not found");
    }
    try
    {
        var result = entity.Both(dto.V);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Results.Ok("ok");
        }
        else
        {
            return Problem(result.Error!);
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        app.Logger.LogError(ex, "Action {Action} failed", "Pair.Both");
        return StatusProblem(500, "Internal Server Error");
    }
});

app.MapPost("/api/pairs/{id}/conflict", async (int id, ConflictDto dto, TDbCtx db) => {
    var entity = await db.Pairs.FindAsync(id);
    if (entity == null)
    {
        return StatusProblem(404, "Not Found", "Pair not found");
    }
    try
    {
        var result = entity.Conflict(dto.S);
        if (result.IsSuccess)
        {
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();
            return Results.Ok("ok");
        }
        else
        {
            return Problem(result.Error!);
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        app.Logger.LogError(ex, "Action {Action} failed", "Pair.Conflict");
        return StatusProblem(500, "Internal Server Error");
    }
});

static IResult Problem(Poly.Runtime.DomainFailure failure)
{
    var extensions = new Dictionary<string, object?>();
    if (failure.ElementPath != null)
    {
        extensions["elementPath"] = failure.ElementPath;
    }
    if (failure.Guard != null)
    {
        extensions["guard"] = failure.Guard;
    }
    return Results.Problem(failure.Message, null, Poly.Runtime.DomainFailureStatus.Http(failure.Kind), failure.Kind.ToString(), null, extensions);
}


static IResult StatusProblem(int status, string title, string? detail = null)
{
    return Results.Problem(detail, null, status, title);
}


static async System.Threading.Tasks.Task SeedAsync(TDbCtx db)
{
    if (db == null)
    {
        return;
    }
    if (await db.Pairs.AnyAsync())
    {
        return;
    }
    var pairResult = T.Pair.Create(50, 50, "Sample", "Sample");
    if (pairResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        db.Add(pairResult.Value);
    }
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
}


app.Run();


internal record PairDto
{
    [Range(0, 100)]
    public long Lo { get; init; }
    [Range(50, 200)]
    public long Hi { get; init; }
    [Required]
    [RegularExpression("^[A-Z]+$")]
    public string Code { get; init; } = default!;
    [Required]
    [RegularExpression("^[0-9]+$")]
    public string Tag { get; init; } = default!;
}

internal record BothDto
{
    [Range(50, 100)]
    public long V { get; init; }
}

internal record ConflictDto
{
    [Required]
    public string S { get; init; } = default!;
}
